Holy_Judge.description: Male human Order vocation: the Maker's arbiter. Reads sin, hears confessions, carries out verdicts. Breath answers him only passively.
Holy_Judge.lore: Holy Judges stand as the Maker's voice, purging corruption with radiant authority, feared even by the Church.

Discern_Sin.roll: Piety + d100 vs Target Willpower + d100
Discern_Sin.effect: Detects major sin only (demon pacts, dark magic, betrayal, murder of innocents). A trained judgement, not a spell.

breath_trigger.target: Veilspawn, abomination or confirmed major sinner

Judgment.effect: Attacks against the target deal +4 damage and its Fear tests against you are at -10.
Judgment.replaces: Judgment Call (old active: 12 holy damage, +15 vs corrupted)

Final_Verdict.effect: Instant kill on confirmed guilty low-HP target; massive damage + fear on high-HP
Final_Verdict.risk: Wrong execution on innocent = heavy piety loss + Order punishment

Purge_Verdict.effect: Allies within 6 m lose Fear and Veil status effects (salt_kiss, taint_mark, brine_marks).
Purge_Verdict.replaces: Purge Verdict (old active: remove status effects, 12 stamina)

Feared_By_The_Flock.effect: -10 Charisma with common folk who know what you are.
